description: agent.changes narrowed to one agent's slug, which is what the management page's History tab asks when it opens one row's history. Two things the whole-ledger answer cannot show. First, the `slug` the caller sent is echoed back beside the rows: a panel that asked for `code-reviewer` and was answered someone else's history is a routing bug, and the echo is how the panel notices. Second, `total` counts the FILTERED set — 7 changes exist in the ledger, 3 of them are this agent's — so the page control under a filtered table says 3 and not 7, which is the number that agrees with the rows underneath it (PG3). The three rows are the three kinds of actor this ledger knows: a person on the socket, the seed engine writing its own content, and the same person deleting the row — and the last one names an agent that no longer exists, because the ledger is where a deleted agent's name survives.
